firmware.releaseNotes: Resets the Bluetooth module once during MCU startup so MCU-only restarts invalidate the old phone connection. Uses a bounded software reset, preserves the selected baud and module configuration, and leaves new-link bytes for the normal protocol. Retains the standalone Check Update menu, styled Chinese dialog and focus-group exit fix. Preserves explicit firmware consent, recorder exclusion, BLE V2 and file management. Full and recovery candidate only; channel publication and selected delta generation remain operator-controlled.
